descriptionChirho: Qal passive participle: that which is chosen, selected, or refined — describing persons as chosen ones or things as choice/pure quality.
Nifal, Hitpael, Piel: to be clean or pure, to purify oneself or show oneself pure, to cleanse or purge out; encompasses both intransitive purity and causative purification including testing/refining.
Hifil: to sharpen or polish (arrows or weapons), a concrete physical sense of making keen-edged.
